Individual configuration files are at most64KiB and the total at most1MiB; uploads cannot supply native XML/font configuration. The described crafted approximately2MiB XML path is outside that input boundary. The original finding remains visible.

findings.rationale: The vulnerable Pod::Text formatter requires the Perl interpreter. The exact image removes the perl-base executable programs and records their removal hashes; its measured /usr/bin/perl absence is mandatory. No application or fixed worker invokes Perl or formats caller-supplied POD. The package inventory and raw scanner finding remain visible; this is not a package-upgrade claim.
findings.compensatingControls: Bind the exact production source, package, image and absent interpreter to qualified owner/CSRF and private/public controls; reject missing, changed, expired or newly observed evidence.
findings.remediationTarget: Recheck vendor fixed Noble package 5.38.2-3.2ubuntu0.7 by 2026-11-18; retain the finding until a new scan verifies remediation.
